confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. One confirmed the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026, the most recent published observation; the server should check it against the RBA page. Two searches checked food and drink prices on travel and cost-of-living sites (nomad.watch, Nomadic Matt, combien-coute.net, southeastasiabackpacker.com, gobackpacking.com). These are crowdsourced and their dates vary. The beer, meal and coffee figures agree well: draft Beerlao about $1-1.50, a cheap meal about $1.50-3 and coffee about $1.20-1.40. The mid-range meal for two is based on one guide that put a mid-range dinner for two with beers at about $19, so it is less certain. I found no reliable current cocktail or wine prices. Those two figures are estimated from their usual price relative to beer and from my general knowledge of backpacker bars in Laos, where wine is imported and costs more. Accommodation figures are model estimates only, not checked against current listings. Lao kip inflation and exchange-rate swings add uncertainty to all figures for July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Vang Vieng-specific aggregated sources where available. The rest is benchmarked against other backpacker towns in Laos and mainland Southeast Asia, such as Luang Prabang (slightly pricier) and Pai in Thailand.
